matches.title: Software Engineering Summer Internship 2027 (London)

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Team

There’s a lot behind a morning coffee order. You could be part of it.

A local café, a courier on the way and a customer ready to start their day. At Deliveroo, we connect people with the food, shops and products they love. As a Software Engineering Intern, you’ll join a team building the technology that makes those connections possible. From creating user-friendly experiences to working on the systems behind them, you’ll help develop, maintain and ship products used by customers, merchants and riders.

You’ll work alongside experienced engineers to solve real problems, with support from a dedicated manager and mentor. Along the way, you’ll build your skills, learn how we develop products at scale and see the impact of your work.

This is a full-time, 12-week internship based at our London HQ, starting in summer 2027. It’s open to students currently enrolled in higher education and in the penultimate year of study. 

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll join a team of engineers building technology that improves the experience of consumers, merchants and Riders. During your 12-week internship, you’ll collaborate with your team to solve customer problems and help develop, maintain and ship products.

  • You’ll contribute to technical projects with support from your manager, mentor and team.
  • You’ll learn about the systems you work on, from user-friendly product experiences to scalable backend architecture.
  • You’ll develop your engineering skills through feedback, coaching and mentorship.
  • You’ll collaborate with your team to solve problems and contribute to business priorities.
  • You’ll take part in intern programming, including leadership speaker sessions and social events, both virtually and in person.
  • You’ll share what you’ve learned in a final presentation at the end of your internship.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

We’re looking for strong engineering foundations and curiosity to learn. Here’s what you’ll need to join us and thrive in the role:

  • You’re pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or an equivalent field and expect to graduate between autumn 2027 and summer 2028.
  • You have no more than two years of full-time work experience.
  • You’re available to start in June 2027 and work in person for the duration of the internship.
  • You have experience working with databases and technologies such as SQL.
  • You have a solid understanding of algorithms and data structures.
  • You’re proficient in at least one object-oriented programming language, such as Python, Java or Kotlin.
  • You have experience writing clean code, using version control and writing unit tests.
  • You’re authorised to work in the UK for the duration of the internship.

Preferred but not required:

  • Previous software engineering internship experience or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Curiosity about and experience using AI-powered tools to support software development, problem-solving and learning, with an understanding of how to evaluate outputs and use these tools responsibly.
  • An ability to analyse and improve the efficiency, scalability and stability of systems.
  • An interest in developing, releasing and running large-scale web applications.
  • Experience with systems monitoring, live deployments or continuous integration.
  • Experience solving real-time technology problems.
  • Experience with service-oriented architecture, writing APIs or designing systems.
  • Participation in technical projects or research, hackathons, conferences, student organisations, teaching assistant roles or other relevant extracurricular activities.

Why Join Us? 

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters - solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. You’ll be paired with a dedicated manager and a mentor while being supported by a community of designers passionate about learning and helping each other grow.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to: 


🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale
      Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱See your impact, fast
     Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership
    environment.

🧠Grow through challenge and ownership
     Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎A culture built for builders
     High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

 Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

 About the Role 

 We’re looking for an experienced, fluent Japanese speaking Database Support Engineer to join our Support Team and help developers unblock complex issues, build more reliably, and get the most out of the Supabase platform. You’ll work closely with customers and engineering, helping us improve product quality and developer experience based on real-world usage.

 This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.

 What You’ll Be Responsible for 

 In this role, you’ll:

 Investigate and resolve advanced customer issues across Postgres, Auth, RLS, Storage, Realtime, Edge Functions, and client libraries.

 Provide consultative, proactive advice to optimize workloads, avoid common pitfalls, and tailored advice to our most advanced users.

 Reproduce bugs, isolate root causes, propose workarounds, and escalate to engineering with solid repro steps.

 Ask smart, targeted questions that turn incomplete reports into actionable cases.

 Communicate clearly and empathetically with customer users of all levels—especially during high-impact or time-sensitive situations.

 Spot patterns across tickets and recommend improvements to docs, tooling, and the product itself.

 Mentor junior team members and help raise the overall bar for support quality.

 You Might Be a Good Fit If You 

 You have 6+ years in technical support, backend engineering, SRE, or similar.

 You know PostgreSQL deeply—autovacuum behavior, WAL growth, long-running transactions, table bloat, and other internals.

 You’re strong in high-performance SQL and query optimization.

 You’re comfortable troubleshooting complex setups, including multi-tenant schema patterns.

 You can debug edge functions and understand distributed system behavior when failures get tricky.

 You’ve handled data migration issues (pg_dump/restore, schema drift, failed migrations) and know how to recover safely.

 You have hands-on experience with cloud hosting providers like AWS.

 You’re comfortable in terminal and Linux environments.

 You thrive in high-volume situations and can form/test assumptions quickly.

 Additional Requirements

 Must be a fluent bilingual Japanese/English Speaker

 Must have experience support complex technical products in Japanese with native speakers

 Ideally located in Japan, but location is flexible as long as you can work during Japan business hours.

 データベースサポートエンジニア

 Supabaseについて
Supabaseは、開発者が開発者のために作ったPostgres開発プラットフォームです。データベース、認証、ストレージ、Edge Functions、リアルタイム機能、ベクトル検索を含む、完全なバックエンドソリューションを提供しています。すべてのサービスは緊密に統合されており、成長に対応できるよう設計されています。

 職務内容について
経験豊富な日本語で対応可能なデータベースサポートエンジニアを募集し、サポートチームに参加していただきます。開発者の複雑な課題解決を支援し、より信頼性の高い開発を実現し、Supabaseプラットフォームを最大限に活用していただけるようサポートします。お客様やグローバルのエンジニアリングチームと密接に連携し、実際の利用状況に基づいて製品品質や開発者体験の向上に貢献していただきます。

 このポジションは、非同期かつスピード感のある環境で力を発揮でき、数百万人規模で利用される開発者ツールの構築にやりがいを感じる方に最適です。

 主な業務内容
このポジションでは、以下の業務を担当していただきます。

 Postgres、認証、RLS、ストレージ、リアルタイム機能、Edge Functions、クライアントライブラリにまたがる高度な顧客課題の調査・解決

 ワークロードの最適化やよくある落とし穴の回避に向けたコンサルティング的かつ積極的なアドバイスの提供、および最も高度なユーザーへの個別対応

 バグの再現、根本原因の特定、回避策の提案、および確実な再現手順を伴うエンジニアリングチームへのエスカレーション

 不完全な報告内容を対応可能な案件に変えるための、的確で的を絞った質問

 あらゆるレベルの顧客ユーザーとの明確かつ思いやりのあるコミュニケーション(特に影響度が高い、または緊急性の高い状況において)

 チケット全体からパターンを見出し、ドキュメント、ツール、製品自体の改善を提案

 ジュニアメンバーの育成、サポート品質全体の向上への貢献

 以下に当てはまる方はこのポジションに向いています

 テクニカルサポート、バックエンドエンジニアリング、SRE、または類似職種で6年以上の経験がある方

 PostgreSQLに関する深い知識をお持ちの方(autovacuumの挙動、WALの増加、長時間実行トランザクション、テーブルの肥大化などの内部構造を含む)

 高パフォーマンスなSQLおよびクエリ最適化に強みをお持ちの方

 マルチテナントのスキーマパターンを含む、複雑な構成のトラブルシューティングに抵抗がない方

 Edge Functionsのデバッグができ、障害が複雑化した際の分散システムの挙動を理解できる方

 データ移行に関する問題(pg_dump/restore、スキーマの差異、移行失敗など)に対応した経験があり、安全な復旧方法を理解している方

 AWSなどのクラウドホスティングプロバイダーでの実務経験がある方

 ターミナルおよびLinux環境に抵抗なく対応できる方

 業務量の多い状況でも力を発揮でき、素早く仮説を立てて検証できる方

 追加要件

 日本語・英語のバイリンガルであること

 日本語の顧客を対象に、技術製品のサポートを行った経験があること

 日本在住が望ましいですが、日本の勤務時間帯に対応できれば勤務地は柔軟に対応可能です

 What We Offer 

 Fully Remote 

 We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

 ESOP 

 Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

 Tech Allowance 

 Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

 Health Benefits 

 Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

 Annual Off-Sites 

 Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

 Flexible Work 

 We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

 Professional Development 

 Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

 About the Team 

 Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

 ~400 team members

 60+ countries

 20+ languages spoken

 Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

 540,000+ community members

 We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

About Mitre Media 

 Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time. 

 Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

 As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

 Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates 

 Problem-solver with a “get things done” mentality 

 Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration 

 Attention to detail, ensuring clean, maintainable code 

 Team player comfortable as an individual contributor 

 Why Join Us? 

 Impactful Work : Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights. 

 Cutting-Edge Tech : Work with Rails 8, LLMs, and modern tools like Hotwire, Databricks, and xAI’s API in a microservices architecture.

 Remote Flexibility : Remote-first (±3 hours from ET) with hybrid in office collaboration in Toronto or NYC 

 Growth Opportunities : Budget for AI and Rails conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, RailsConf), plus access to cutting-edge AI tools for experimentation.

 Mitre Media powers premium financial brands like Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com with the Mitre Platform. This platform integrates traditional content management, financial data, first-party data, ad revenue, and subscription tools, all enhanced by LLMs for rich, user-focused experiences. Our data-derived insights delight users, while our advertising solutions deliver unmatched performance for partners like BlackRock and Vanguard, leveraging advanced targeting and first-party data.

 Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. adjoe Ads is our programmatic in-app advertising platform that seamlessly connects advertisers and publishers through direct integration of our Android and iOS SDKs. Every ad decision happens in under 200ms across 10 million daily users, powered by real-time bidding algorithms and user quality prediction models that match the right ad to the right user at the right moment.

 Engine Behind 120M Processed Auctions Daily

 The Ad Network team builds and operates the backend services that power adjoe Ads' programmatic advertising engine. The core challenge is straightforward to state and hard to solve: for every incoming ad request from a mobile SDK, decide within milliseconds whether it's a good fit for any active campaign — and at what price to bid.

To solve this, the team has built a Real-Time Bidding platform of 20+ Go microservices that orchestrate ad auctions at 1,500 bid requests per second , integrate with external demand partners via OpenRTB , and connect to ML models making 50 billion predictions daily across 600+ features to optimize bid pricing.  Golang Backend Foundation: You have a Computer Science degree (or related field) and hands-on experience writing Golang. You will use this foundation to contribute directly to our production backend services from day one at adjoe, rather than writing isolated or throwaway code.

 Proven Project Portfolio: We look for engineers with tangible projects to show, not just coursework. You will leverage the architectural lessons from your past builds—what worked, why you built it, and what you would change—to design and scale our live systems.

 Modern Infrastructure Stack: You are comfortable working with REST APIs, version control via Git, and CI/CD pipelines. You will use these core tools, along with your familiarity in cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure, to reliably deploy your code into our environments.

 Iterative Code Ownership: You will work alongside experienced engineers who will rigorously review your pull requests. We need someone who parses technical feedback directly and uses it to continuously refine their system design and coding standards.

 🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team. 

 What’s in It for You? 
 At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

 Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.

 We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

Met quizzen, enquêtes en winacties stimuleren we die interactie iedere dag. Wil jij ervaring opdoen en meewerken aan een inspirerende omgeving? Lees dan snel verder!

 Wat ga je doen?
 Als stagiair Community- en Interactieredacteur speel je een actieve rol in het versterken van de verbinding tussen onze lezers en de redactie. Jij zorgt ervoor dat onze online community betrokken blijft en levert waardevolle inzichten die bijdragen aan nieuwe verhalen en content. Dit doe je onder andere door: 
 li]:mb-1 [&>li::marker]:text-base [&>li::marker]:text-gray-900 dark:[&>li::marker]:text-gray-100"> Onderwerpen, stellingen, quizzen en enquêtes te bedenken die lezers uitnodigen om actief mee te praten. 

 Winacties te ontwikkelen en uit te voeren in samenwerking met de redactie en marketeers. 

 Reacties op onze website en socialmediakanalen te modereren en online gesprekken op een prettige manier te begeleiden volgens onze huisregels. 

 Te signaleren welke onderwerpen leven onder onze lezers en deze inzichten te delen met de redactie. 

 Actief mee te denken over nieuwe ideeën en verbeteringen op het gebied van communitymanagement en online engagement. 

 Je maakt onderdeel uit van een betrokken en ervaren redactie, waar je veel ruimte krijgt om ideeën aan te dragen en praktijkervaring op te doen.

 Wie zijn wij?
 Wij zijn Libelle, een van de grootste en meest vertrouwde magazinemerken van Nederland. Met inspirerende verhalen, praktische tips en herkenbare onderwerpen bereiken we dagelijks een grote en betrokken doelgroep via ons magazine, onze website, app en socialmediakanalen. We bouwen continu aan een sterke community waarin lezers elkaar én onze redactie weten te vinden.

 Wat maakt jou de ideale kandidaat?
 Voor deze stage zoeken wij een nieuwsgierige en betrokken student met interesse in online communities en digitale content. Daarnaast: 
 li]:mb-1 [&>li::marker]:text-base [&>li::marker]:text-gray-900 dark:[&>li::marker]:text-gray-100"> Je volgt een relevante hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Communicatie, Media, Journalistiek of Commerciële Economie. 

 Je bent nieuwsgierig naar wat er leeft onder onze lezers. 

 Je vindt het leuk om online gesprekken op gang te brengen en mensen met elkaar te verbinden. 

 Je kunt zorgvuldig, objectief en zelfstandig afwegingen maken. 

 Je denkt graag mee over nieuwe ideeën en verbeteringen.

 Bij DPG Media staan we open voor alle talent in de maatschappij. Ongeacht je achtergrond, nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren op deze functie. Juist door de verschillen tussen collega’s ontstaan verrassende inzichten en innovatieve oplossingen. En dat past dan weer heel erg goed bij ons als organisatie.  Bij ons krijg je een inspirerende werkomgeving die continu in beweging is. Collega’s die denken in mogelijkheden, het glas halfvol zien en we geven jou de kans je dagelijks te ontwikkelen. Dit doen we onder andere door onze DPG Academy. Dit geeft jou alle mogelijkheid het beste uit jezelf te halen en een echte mediamaker te zijn! 
 li]:mb-1 [&>li::marker]:text-base [&>li::marker]:text-gray-900 dark:[&>li::marker]:text-gray-100"> 💰 Een passende stagevergoeding van 400 euro p/m.
